hypothesis_boundary: US semiconductor manufacturing producer prices may measure sector price pressure distinct from Fed capacity utilization and Korea export demand; source qualification is not predictive evidence.
source_authority: BLS PPI distributed as dated ALFRED historical vintages
download_format: Observations by Vintage Date, All Observations
release_timing: ALFRED date-level version only; BLS PPI release currently scheduled 08:30 ET. Any eventual signal must wait until the next Qlib-supported trading session after the archive vintage date. Intraday first reception and historical all-month 08:30 release clock remain unproved.
revision_and_definition_caveats: BLS says PPI values can be revised up to four months after first publication.
BLS 2024 hedonic microprocessor adjustment may affect comparability of the aggregate semiconductor industry price index; any structural break must be reported before modeling.
US quality-adjusted producer prices are not global semiconductor sales, memory spot prices or SOXX fair value.
Adjacent-month changes must use values from one vintage column, never initial values from different release dates.
stop_conditions: Wrong ALFRED series, selected vintage count other than 93, changed form format or URL: stop before POST.
Non-ZIP/oversize response, wrong README identity/output format or unexpected CSV structure: preserve raw bytes and stop qualification.
Missing, nonsensical or revised-only values: report source gap; no market read or model.
